label: Finance Act 2026 (assessment years 2026-27 and 2027-28)
applies_to: Resident individuals with salary income. The same rates apply to the return filed in 2026-27 and to monthly salary tax deduction during income year 2026-27.
confidence_notes: General threshold Tk 4,00,000 is confirmed by The Daily Star report on the passed Finance Bill (29 June 2026).

Category thresholds (women/65+ Tk 4.5 lakh, disabled & third gender Tk 5.25 lakh, gazetted war-wounded freedom fighters & July warriors Tk 5.5 lakh) follow the enacted figures reported by Roy Law Nexus (Aug 2026); the Finance Bill had proposed Tk 25,000 less for each. Some guides still show the bill figures.

Slab widths, investment rebate (lowest of 3% of taxable income, 10% of investment, Tk 7.5 lakh) and the flat Tk 5,000 minimum tax follow the KPMG/Rahman Rahman Huq summary of Finance Bill 2026 and post-Act guides.
Salary exemption (lower of one-third of salary or Tk 5 lakh) follows Roy Law Nexus and Arthonitee guides.
Verify against the Finance Act 2026 gazette on nbr.gov.bd before filing.

sources.name: The Daily Star: Finance bill passed, tax-free income threshold set at Tk 4 lakh for FY2026-27
